purpose: Implementation planning coverage, not a compatibility result or test certificate

statusMeaning.partial: Some related local capability exists; no API or behavior parity claimed
statusMeaning.missing: No implementation of the named responsibility found in the inspected local source

localBaseline.scope: Working branch including subsequent record milestone changes beyond the recorded baseline; not necessarily merged main or published npm

modules.gap: Exact rational/algebraic arithmetic, canonical equation bases, and correlated linear/quadratic fiber reconstruction exist; general rounded intervals, transcendental enclosures and a certified approximation policy remain incomplete. Quadratic fiber images now retain the common algebraic coefficient field through the radical/division formula, with an independent cubic-source/degree-six regression.
Exact vectors, planes and cylinders exist; a complete analytic surface family and common transform/placement API are missing.

Positive rational weights, evaluation, derivatives, knot operations and sufficient affine/triangular face-embedding certificates exist. A rational-weight cylinder wall/cap path now has fixed integration coverage. General fitting, degree editing, complete embedding tests and broad imported-data coverage remain missing.

Exact geometry/topology records and supported analytic face definitions exist; constructed NURBS source BRep recipes replay source/target and both trim domains without serialized certification claims. Arbitrary imported NURBS/procedural domains, independent pcurves and persistent feature IDs remain incomplete. A NURBS Body recipe document now replays all source faces, sewing, global embedding, containment, orientation and region-sample checks through common Body restoration. Optional rational separation planes are untrusted search hints checked against whole finite faces during replay; they are not stored proof flags. Capped NURBS Body documents now store parent source recipes plus one plane/side and replay all geometry/material gates through the common restore API; no serialized certification flags are accepted.

Certified finite source faces enter shared incidence and supported rational maps sew across sources. Sufficient pairwise separation certificates now gate global embeddings, containment forests and alternating material orientation. Complete general embedding discovery, general SSI maps and full NURBS operation dispatch remain incomplete. Closed capped halfspace surfaces now inherit embedding under complete finite transverse section certificates, retain unsupported degeneracies, and recompute new shell containment via exact shell rays. Owned new-shell material certification now checks actual orientation and strict material-region samples; child Body adoption remains incomplete.

Supported analytic domains and constructed NURBS source recipes reconstruct geometry and re-run applicable face and boundary checks. Weighted wall/circular-cap recipes rebuild exact sewn queries in regression. Arbitrary imported face/shell certification, independent pcurves, complete imported-data void containment and full NURBS operation dispatch remain incomplete.

Box, finite/clipped Cylinder, vertical Extrude, planar materials, manifold finite-cylinder expressions and repeated halfspace-clipped expressions share owned Body records, derived regions, bounded-face queries and replay-checked persistence. Restored cylinder-family Bodies can append cuts. Clipped-leaf Boolean reuse, general curved operations, arbitrary record-to-solid certification and feature history remain missing. Certified NURBS materials now join KernelBody3 with owned topology, cavity-aware region samples, point/face/line/ray queries and replayed source-only persistence. NURBS similarity transforms now rebuild exact source/target controls, flip reflected face senses, and revalidate covariantly transformed separation-plane hints. General NURBS Booleans, repeated/degenerate splitting, arbitrary affine transforms and mass properties remain incomplete. Certified single-plane NURBS cut materials now adopt as owned KernelBody3 children, split from source NURBS Bodies through common dispatch, persist/replay and rebuild under reflected similarities. Capped-body repeated cuts and mixed/native interface atoms remain explicit unsupported operations.
A common axis-aligned Box/finite Cylinder API and vertical profile Extrude exist. Complete sphere/cone/torus/pyramid constructors and broader placements remain missing.

Owned cylinder walls and planar caps support multi-cylinder/plane arrangements, exact side vectors and bounded-domain replay. Arbitrary NURBS spatial face topology and general curved trimming remain incomplete.

Native analytic and existing NURBS intersections coexist with owned cylinder SSI graphs, exact plane trims and third-cylinder SSI recovery. Finite-cylinder expression plane sections and closed cut boundaries exist. General analytic/NURBS SSI, complete contact relations and broader clipped-material operations remain incomplete. Certified finite NURBS faces now expose exact plane-section vertices, trimmed implicit graph intervals and coplanar finite-face domains, including holes and isolated contacts. Complete cross-face noding, cap material selection and NURBS Body plane splitting remain incomplete.

Supported analytic finite-cylinder/halfspace boundaries share planar conic and curved-wall partitions, strict two-sided material selection, native/SSI provenance and balanced sewing with incidence diagnostics. General curved embeddings, maximal consolidation and common adoption of arbitrary assembled solids remain incomplete. Certified NURBS materials support finite-face plane loci and sufficient oriented section wires, with degenerate cases retained. Signed UV cells now close, join across patch seams, match recovered original rational trim paths to canonical source curves, insert shared-edge refinements, adopt region loops into BRep split faces and sew all original faces using interval endpoint unions. Cap boundary curves retain native intervals; complete plane events and independent algebraic point queries provide exact per-loop winding with budgeted retries.
